rationale: Per-space external-screen presentation, a physical reference camera and shared UI Kit layout changes introduce a new user-facing capability. The v1 decoder stays read-only until an explicit outer Save; ordinary old writers cannot downgrade v2.

summary.ru: Отдельный вид каждого пространства внешнего экрана: масштаб, поворот и учёт сводки, общий конструктор и UI Kit.
summary.en: Per-space external-screen views with scale, rotation and summary-aware centering, using the shared constructor and UI Kit.
